creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The owner asked on 2026-11-20 (chat note) to color a tab or a single pane and to group tabs more visibly in the sidebar, and to settle it with mock-ups first: the mock-up defines the task, then it gets built.

So this card is the mock-up, as a Lectern page like muster-ui-redesign was: a color the person assigns to a tab, one assigned to a single pane, and how a tab's panes read as one group in the agent list. Show where each color appears (row, pane header, tab) and how it sits beside state colors and machine dots. The redesign's chrome-colors decision (`fencil show chrome-colors`) says Muster takes on no theme and new surfaces derive their colors from existing settings; a color the person picks is a setting, so this fits it, but the mock-up should say so. Once the owner picks, file the build as cards under this one.
title: Mock up tab and pane colors and more visible tab groups in the sidebar
